scripts.docker:debug: docker compose -f compose.yaml -f compose.override.yaml -f compose.debug.yaml -p fcp-sfd-bank-details up
scripts.docker:test: mkdir -p coverage && docker compose -p fcp-sfd-bank-details-test down -v && docker compose -f compose.yaml -f compose.test.yaml -p fcp-sfd-bank-details-test run --build --rm fcp-sfd-bank-details
scripts.docker:test:watch: docker compose -p fcp-sfd-bank-details-test down -v && docker compose -f compose.yaml -f compose.test.yaml -f compose.test.watch.yaml -p fcp-sfd-bank-details-test run --build --rm fcp-sfd-bank-details
scripts.setup:husky: node -e "try { (await import('husky')).default() } catch (e) { if (e.code !== 'ERR_MODULE_NOT_FOUND') throw e }" --input-type module
scripts.start:debug: AWS_EMF_ENVIRONMENT=Local NODE_ENV=development JWT_AUTH_BYPASS=true nodemon --watch src --exec 'node --inspect-brk=0.0.0.0 --env-file-if-exists=.env src/index.js'
scripts.start:watch: AWS_EMF_ENVIRONMENT=Local NODE_ENV=development JWT_AUTH_BYPASS=true nodemon --watch src --exec 'node --inspect=0.0.0.0 --env-file-if-exists=.env src/index.js'
scripts.test: npm run lint && TZ=UTC vitest run --coverage
